stack.framework: Astro 5.7 (static site, no client-side JS framework island detected)

notes_stack: package.json deps: astro ^5.7.0, @astrojs/sitemap, @fontsource-variable/fraunces, @fontsource-variable/inter, sharp. Plain CSS (src/styles/global.css), no Tailwind, no component library.
table_or_list_ui_evidence: grep for <table|<ul|<ol|role="table"|grid-cols across src/**/*.astro: only <ul> hits (src/pages/index.astro:246,296,306,315; src/components/Header.astro:38) — nav and footer link lists, not data lists.

src/data/menu.js (240 lines) holds the restaurant menu as a JS array of category/item objects; rendered as marketing cards/sections on the one page (src/pages/index.astro), not a table or sortable/filterable list.
app_shape: single-page restaurant marketing site: src/pages/index.astro, src/components/{Hero,HeroScene,Header,PapelPicado}.astro, src/layouts/Base.astro, src/data/{site,menu}.js
notes: 5-page-equivalent marketing site for a restaurant (Camino Real). No admin/dashboard surface, no data fetched from an API at runtime, no table/pagination/sort UI of any kind. Not a candidate for the shared data-table effort.
